headline: Apple and Google services hit by outage
summary: iCloud and other Apple services, including iCloud Mail, Apple School Manager and Schoolwork, suffered an outage; Google's Gmail was also affected. Apple's status page confirmed the outage, and Apple later said it was resolved, while Google said it saw no internal signs of a problem.
